comment: MicroHealth's FIPS base images, pinned tag@digest. Every container the workflows and scripts build starts FROM one of these, read through scripts/fips-image.sh, which refuses anything but a microhealthllc/fips-* image in MicroHealth's ECR pinned by sha256. The pins live here and not in the workflows so that the bump (fips-base-images.yml, scripts/fips_bump.py) never edits .github/workflows/. CI and release.yml refuse a stale pin (fips_bump.py --check).
